description: This file defines an Android activity 'LoaderRetained' with an inner fragment class 'CursorLoaderListFragment' that demonstrates using a CursorLoader to load and display contacts in a list with search filtering.

classes.name: LoaderRetained
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating contact list loading with a retained fragment.

classes.name: LoaderRetained.CursorLoaderListFragment
classes.description: Fragment displaying a list of contacts loaded via CursorLoader with search filtering.

classes.name: LoaderRetained.CursorLoaderListFragment.MySearchView
classes.description: Custom SearchView that clears its query when collapsed.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and adds the list fragment if not already present.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list, adapter, and loader in the fragment.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the search menu item with custom SearchView.

methods.name: onQueryTextChange
methods.description: Handles search query text changes, updates filter, and restarts loader.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Clears search query when search view is closed.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader for contacts, applying filter if present.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps in the new cursor when loading is finished.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the cursor in the adapter when loader is reset.
